speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the consultation, I am Dr. Agent. As a newborn, your condition requires a careful history and physical exam; since I cannot ask you questions directly, I will rely on the clinical presentation provided by your caregivers. Please describe the specific symptoms you have noticed, such as breathing difficulties, skin discoloration, or feeding issues. Additionally, tell me how long the baby has been sick and if there are any recent changes in their behavior or weight.

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Syphilis. The mother's lack of prenatal care and missing immunization records, combined with the newborn's status, raises high suspicion for congenital syphilis; please request serology (VDRL/RPR for mother and infant) and a direct fluorescent antibody test on the umbilical cord stump.
